title: Personal Finance Overview
description: Financial command center with automatic MXN/USD conversion, simplified visual charts, and explicit interest tracking.

query.rawSql: SELECT name FROM finance.accounts WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END)), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount > 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), classified AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') <> 'Sin categoría' THEN c.name WHEN t.description ~* '(openai|chatgpt|cloudflare|github|google one|apple tv|apple tv shows|amazon web services|aws|canva|notion|adobe|spotify|netflix)' THEN 'Suscripciones' WHEN t.description ~* '(panera|velvet taco|first watch|ihop|mcdonald''s|in[- ]?n[- ]?out|emelias|papparoti|gill ice cream|sr\.? ozzy|chili''s|paris baguette|denny''s|matsui)' THEN 'Restaurantes' WHEN t.description ~* '(costco|kroger|target|whole foods|wf dallas|walmart|soriana|chedraui|la suprema market|dollar tree)' THEN 'Supermercado' WHEN t.description ~* '(city of frisco utilities|municipal online payments|atmos energy|gexa energy|telcel|telmex|total play|ntta autochargeplan|dino clean car wash|prosper ford|mobile x global)' THEN 'Servicios' WHEN t.description ~* '(oxxo|7-eleven|circle k|qt|racetrac|buc-ee''s|365 vend)' THEN 'Conveniencia' WHEN t.description ~* '(walgreens|urgent care|pharmacy)' THEN 'Salud' WHEN t.description ~* '(dancemakers|sci-tech)' THEN 'Entretenimiento' WHEN t.description ~* '(infonavit)' THEN 'Renta/Hipoteca' WHEN t.description ~* '(marshalls|supercuts)' THEN 'Ropa' ELSE 'Sin categoría' END AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Sin categoría' THEN display_amount ELSE 0 END)), 0) AS value FROM classified
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), classified AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') <> 'Sin categoría' THEN c.name WHEN t.description ~* '(openai|chatgpt|cloudflare|github|google one|apple tv|apple tv shows|amazon web services|aws|canva|notion|adobe|spotify|netflix)' THEN 'Suscripciones' WHEN t.description ~* '(panera|velvet taco|first watch|ihop|mcdonald''s|in[- ]?n[- ]?out|emelias|papparoti|gill ice cream|sr\.? ozzy|chili''s|paris baguette|denny''s|matsui)' THEN 'Restaurantes' WHEN t.description ~* '(costco|kroger|target|whole foods|wf dallas|walmart|soriana|chedraui|la suprema market|dollar tree)' THEN 'Supermercado' WHEN t.description ~* '(city of frisco utilities|municipal online payments|atmos energy|gexa energy|telcel|telmex|total play|ntta autochargeplan|dino clean car wash|prosper ford|mobile x global)' THEN 'Servicios' WHEN t.description ~* '(oxxo|7-eleven|circle k|qt|racetrac|buc-ee''s|365 vend)' THEN 'Conveniencia' WHEN t.description ~* '(walgreens|urgent care|pharmacy)' THEN 'Salud' WHEN t.description ~* '(dancemakers|sci-tech)' THEN 'Entretenimiento' WHEN t.description ~* '(infonavit)' THEN 'Renta/Hipoteca' WHEN t.description ~* '(marshalls|supercuts)' THEN 'Ropa' ELSE 'Sin categoría' END AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN category <> 'Sin categoría' THEN ABS(display_amount) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(display_amount)), 0), 1), 0) AS value FROM classified

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), 
base AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', t.txn_date)::timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') <> 'Sin categoría' THEN c.name WHEN t.description ~* '(openai|chatgpt|cloudflare|github|google one|apple tv|apple tv shows|amazon web services|aws|canva|notion|adobe|spotify|netflix)' THEN 'Suscripciones' WHEN t.description ~* '(panera|velvet taco|first watch|ihop|mcdonald''s|in[- ]?n[- ]?out|emelias|papparoti|gill ice cream|sr\.? ozzy|chili''s|paris baguette|denny''s|matsui)' THEN 'Restaurantes' WHEN t.description ~* '(costco|kroger|target|whole foods|wf dallas|walmart|soriana|chedraui|la suprema market|dollar tree)' THEN 'Supermercado' WHEN t.description ~* '(city of frisco utilities|municipal online payments|atmos energy|gexa energy|telcel|telmex|total play|ntta autochargeplan|dino clean car wash|prosper ford|mobile x global)' THEN 'Servicios' WHEN t.description ~* '(oxxo|7-eleven|circle k|qt|racetrac|buc-ee''s|365 vend)' THEN 'Conveniencia' WHEN t.description ~* '(walgreens|urgent care|pharmacy)' THEN 'Salud' WHEN t.description ~* '(dancemakers|sci-tech)' THEN 'Entretenimiento' WHEN t.description ~* '(infonavit)' THEN 'Renta/Hipoteca' WHEN t.description ~* '(marshalls|supercuts)' THEN 'Ropa' ELSE 'Otros' END AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND 'MXN' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND 'MXN' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '.*') 
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1d'), category, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "value" FROM base GROUP BY 1, category ORDER BY 1, category

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', t.txn_date)::timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'), daily AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(SUM(display_amount), 0) AS net FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) SELECT time, SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Cumulative Net Flow" FROM daily ORDER BY time

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), 
classified AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') <> 'Sin categoría' THEN c.name WHEN t.description ~* '(openai|chatgpt|cloudflare|github|google one|apple tv|apple tv shows|amazon web services|aws|canva|notion|adobe|spotify|netflix)' THEN 'Suscripciones' WHEN t.description ~* '(panera|velvet taco|first watch|ihop|mcdonald''s|in[- ]?n[- ]?out|emelias|papparoti|gill ice cream|sr\.? ozzy|chili''s|paris baguette|denny''s|matsui)' THEN 'Restaurantes' WHEN t.description ~* '(costco|kroger|target|whole foods|wf dallas|walmart|soriana|chedraui|la suprema market|dollar tree)' THEN 'Supermercado' WHEN t.description ~* '(city of frisco utilities|municipal online payments|atmos energy|gexa energy|telcel|telmex|total play|ntta autochargeplan|dino clean car wash|prosper ford|mobile x global)' THEN 'Servicios' WHEN t.description ~* '(oxxo|7-eleven|circle k|qt|racetrac|buc-ee''s|365 vend)' THEN 'Conveniencia' WHEN t.description ~* '(walgreens|urgent care|pharmacy)' THEN 'Salud' WHEN t.description ~* '(dancemakers|sci-tech)' THEN 'Entretenimiento' WHEN t.description ~* '(infonavit)' THEN 'Renta/Hipoteca' WHEN t.description ~* '(marshalls|supercuts)' THEN 'Ropa' ELSE 'Otros' END AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND 'MXN' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND 'MXN' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '.*') 
SELECT category, ROUND(ABS(SUM(display_amount))::numeric, 2) AS total FROM classified GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Merchant", ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Total" FROM tx GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 12

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), 
tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS source, CASE WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND 'MXN' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND 'MXN' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount > 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '.*') 
SELECT source, ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS total FROM tx GROUP BY source ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 15

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', t.txn_date)::timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account' AND (t.description ILIKE '%INTEREST%' OR t.description ILIKE '%INTERÉS%' OR t.description ILIKE '%FINANCE CHARGE%' OR t.description ILIKE '%CARGO POR INTERESES%' OR t.description ILIKE '%COMMISSION%' OR t.description ILIKE '%FEE%')) SELECT time, SUM(amount) AS "Interest & Fees" FROM base GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Merchant", ROUND(AVG(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Amount" FROM tx GROUP BY merchant HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY "Avg Amount" DESC LIMIT 10

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Merchant", ROUND(MAX(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Largest Amount" FROM base GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY "Largest Amount" DESC LIMIT 10

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END)), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account' AND (t.description ILIKE '%INTEREST%' OR t.description ILIKE '%INTERÉS%' OR t.description ILIKE '%FINANCE CHARGE%' OR t.description ILIKE '%CARGO POR INTERESES%' OR t.description ILIKE '%COMMISSION%' OR t.description ILIKE '%FEE%')
